scope: Focused strictly on search-and-retrieval (known-item, descriptive, constraint, absence). Dedicated similar-to and cross-domain recommendations excluded per product pivot.

exclusion_reasons.similar_to: Dedicated reference-based recommendation requests (e.g. recommend anime similar to Death Note) are outside search-and-retrieval product scope.
exclusion_reasons.multi_domain: Cross-domain recommendation requests (e.g. find movies and books by Stephen King) are outside single-domain search scope.
